form.label: Integrated Incident Response Lab
form.description: Safe-simulation authentication, file, process, and network evidence.

search.query: index=ir_lab ("Failed password" OR "event=failed_login") | rex field=_raw "(?:from\s+|src_ip=)(?<src_ip>\d{1,3}(?:\.\d{1,3}){3})" | stats count earliest(_time) as first_seen latest(_time) as last_seen by src_ip | convert ctime(first_seen) ctime(last_seen) | sort - count

index=ir_lab | eval event_type=case(searchmatch("failed_login") OR searchmatch("Failed password"),"failed_login",searchmatch("login_success") OR searchmatch("Accepted password"),"login_success",searchmatch("sensitive_file") OR searchmatch("ir_sensitive"),"file_change",searchmatch("benign_process_started"),"process",searchmatch("ioc_marker"),"ioc_marker",true(),"other") | timechart span=1m count by event_type
index=ir_lab ("ir_sensitive" OR "sensitive_file_modified" OR "/opt/ir-lab/sensitive") | table _time host sourcetype user process path _raw | sort _time
index=ir_lab | sort 0 _time | table _time host source sourcetype _raw
